text.headline: Timeline of Vietnam
text.text: Major events in the history of Vietnam.

events.headline: Han Rule Begins
events.text: Vietnam becomes part of the Han Empire, influencing culture and administration.

events.headline: Bạch Đằng Victory
events.text: Ngô Quyền defeats the Chinese, securing independence.

events.headline: Lê Dynasty
events.text: Lê Lợi expels the Ming and restores independence.

events.headline: French Colonization
events.text: France invades and forms French Indochina.

events.headline: Independence Declared
events.text: Ho Chi Minh proclaims independence after WWII.

events.headline: Dien Bien Phu
events.text: Vietnamese forces defeat the French; country divides at the 17th parallel.

events.headline: War Escalates
events.text: U.S. intensifies involvement in the Vietnam War.

events.headline: Fall of Saigon
events.text: North Vietnam captures Saigon; reunification follows.

events.headline: Đổi Mới
events.text: Economic reforms transition to a socialist-oriented market economy.

events.headline: Growth & Integration
events.text: Vietnam becomes one of Asia’s fastest-growing economies.
